repos_data.description: MCP server for Diagrams.so. 23 tools that let an AI agent generate, edit and review cloud architecture diagrams as native draw.io files.

repo_meta_data.description: Understand any codebase in 60 seconds - an MCP server, CLI and GitHub Action that turns any repo into an architecture diagram (Mermaid/Graphviz) and enforces architecture rules in CI. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client.
